description.en: Structural and functional organization of eukaryotic and prokaryotic cells, membrane transport, organelle biogenesis, signaling pathways, and cell cycle checkpoints.
description.hinglish: Eukaryotic aur prokaryotic cells ka structural aur functional organization, membrane transport, cell organelles, signal transduction, aur cell cycle regulation.

overview.en: Cell Biology is the fundamental bedrock of all biotechnological inquiry. It deals with subcellular architecture, dynamic biomembrane fluidity, vesicular trafficking via Golgi and ER, cytoskeletal mechanics, and apoptotic cascades crucial for biomanufacturing and cellular engineering.
overview.hinglish: Cell biology biotechnology ki basic foundation hai. Isme membrane dynamics, organelles ke internal functions, signal transduction pathways, aur cell division mechanisms covered hain.

en: Understand phospholipid bilayer dynamics and transport kinetics across selective membranes
Analyze protein sorting pathways between Endoplasmic Reticulum, Golgi complex, and lysosomes
Examine GPCR and Receptor Tyrosine Kinase (RTK) signal transduction cascades
Trace cell cycle control points (Cyclins, CDKs) and apoptotic intrinsic/extrinsic pathways
hinglish: Cell membrane ki structure aur selective transport mechanisms ko accurately samajhna
Protein sorting aur intracellular vesicular transport pathways ko trace karna
GPCR aur RTK signaling cascades ke molecular switches ko master karna
Cell cycle checkpoints (Cyclin-CDK complex) aur apoptosis pathways ko verify karna

description.en: Calculates the equilibrium electrical potential across an ion-permeable cell membrane.
description.hinglish: Cell membrane ke across electrochemical equilibrium potential calculate karne ke liye use hota hai.

references.citation: Alberts B. et al. Molecular Biology of the Cell. 7th Edition, W. W. Norton & Company.
Lodish H. et al. Molecular Cell Biology. 9th Edition, Macmillan Learning.

title.hinglish: Cell Membrane Structure aur Transport Mechanisms
Fluid Mosaic Model aur Membrane Asymmetry

topics.contentEn: Phospholipid bilayers form the basic structural matrix of biological membranes. The fluid mosaic model describes dynamic lateral diffusion of lipids and integral membrane proteins.
topics.contentHinglish: Phospholipid bilayer cell membrane ka basic matrix banati hai. Fluid mosaic model lipid aur proteins ke dynamic lateral movement ko explain karta hai.
keyPoints: Amphipathic phosphoglycerides and sphingolipids form bilayers spontaneously in aqueous environments
Flippases, floppases, and scramblases maintain transverse lipid asymmetry
Cholesterol functions as a bidirectional fluidity buffer maintaining membrane integrity across temperatures

title.en: Passive Diffusion, Ion Channels & ABC Transporters
title.hinglish: Passive Diffusion, Ion Channels aur Active ABC Transporters

topics.contentEn: Solute movement across biomembranes operates via simple diffusion, facilitated carrier proteins, voltage-gated channels, and primary/secondary active transporters.
topics.contentHinglish: Biomembrane ke across molecules simple diffusion, facilitated diffusion, aur ATP-dependent primary/secondary active transport dwara move karte hain.
keyPoints: Na+/K+ ATPase establishes the fundamental -70mV resting potential via 3 Na+ out / 2 K+ in stoichiometry
ABC transporters utilize ATP hydrolysis cassettes to pump multidrug xenobiotics and peptides

title.hinglish: Cell Organelles aur Protein Sorting Pathways

topics.contentEn: Nascent polypeptide chains bearing N-terminal signal peptides are targeted to the ER translocon by Signal Recognition Particle (SRP) and folded by BiP and calnexin.
topics.contentHinglish: SRP nascent peptide signal sequence ko recognize karke ribosome ko ER translocon par bind karwata hai jaha BiP chaperone protein folding facilitate karta hai.
keyPoints: SRP binds hydrophobic signal peptides halting elongation until docking with SRP receptor
N-linked glycosylation transfers Glc3Man9GlcNAc2 oligosaccharide onto Asn residues at Asn-X-Ser/Thr motifs

title.en: GPCR, Adenylyl Cyclase & Phospholipase C Cascades
title.hinglish: GPCR Signaling, cAMP aur IP3/DAG Cascades

topics.contentEn: Heterotrimeric G-proteins transduce extracellular ligand binding into intracellular second messenger generation via cAMP, IP3, DAG, and Ca2+ fluxes.
topics.contentHinglish: Ligand binding se 7-transmembrane GPCR conformational change undergo karta hai, jo Ga-GTP dissociation se adenylyl cyclase ya PLC-beta ko activate karta hai.
keyPoints: Gas activates adenylyl cyclase elevating intracellular cAMP which activates Protein Kinase A (PKA)
Gaq activates Phospholipase C-beta cleaving PIP2 into IP3 (releasing ER Ca2+) and DAG (activating PKC)

title.hinglish: Cell Cycle Checkpoints aur Apoptosis Mechanisms

title.en: G1/S, G2/M Checkpoints & p53 DNA Damage Response
title.hinglish: Cell Cycle Checkpoints aur p53 Pathway

topics.contentEn: Cell division fidelity is guaranteed by strict surveillance checkpoints governed by Cyclin-CDK complexes, Wee1/Cdc25 kinases, and the p53-p21 tumor suppressor axis.
topics.contentHinglish: Cell cycle checkpoints DNA damage par division ko halt karte hain. ATM/ATR kinase activation se p53 stabilize hota hai jo p21 CDK inhibitor express karta hai.
keyPoints: Cyclin D-CDK4/6 phosphorylates Retinoblastoma (Rb) protein, releasing E2F to transcribe S-phase genes
Intrinsic apoptosis involves mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) releasing cytochrome c to form the apoptosome with Apaf-1 and procaspase-9

description.en: Thermodynamics of biological systems, structure and conformational kinetics of proteins, carbohydrate metabolism, lipid biosynthesis, and enzyme kinetics.
description.hinglish: Biological systems ki thermodynamics, proteins ki 3D conformational dynamics, enzyme kinetics, glycolysis, Krebs cycle, aur lipid metabolism.

overview.en: Biochemistry bridges molecular architecture with cellular bioenergetics. It explores amino acid ionization, Ramachandran steric constraints, steady-state enzyme mechanics, and ATP generation via the mitochondrial electron transport chain.
overview.hinglish: Biochemistry biomolecules ke chemical structure aur energy conversions ko explain karti hai. Isme amino acids ke Ramachandran plots, Michaelis-Menten enzyme kinetics, aur metabolic pathways jaise Glycolysis aur oxidative phosphorylation detailed covered hain.

en: Calculate steady-state enzyme kinetics parameters using Michaelis-Menten and Lineweaver-Burk transformations
Analyze protein folding free-energy landscapes, secondary motifs, and tertiary stabilization bonds
Trace carbon flux through Glycolysis, TCA cycle, Gluconeogenesis, and Pentose Phosphate Pathway
Compute Gibbs free energy changes for bioenergetic reactions in oxidative phosphorylation
hinglish: Michaelis-Menten equation aur Lineweaver-Burk plots se Km aur Vmax accurately nikalna
Proteins ke secondary structure aur Ramachandran plot angles ko analyze karna
Central metabolic pathways (Glycolysis, Krebs cycle, ETC) me ATP balance sheet calculate karna
Enzyme inhibition types (Competitive, Non-competitive, Uncompetitive) me Lineweaver-Burk shifts samajhna

description.en: Relates reaction velocity to substrate concentration for hyperbolic single-substrate enzymes.
description.hinglish: Substrate concentration aur enzyme reaction speed ke relationship ko describe karta hai.

description.en: Determines the pH of a physiological buffer solution based on conjugate base/acid ratio.
description.hinglish: Biological buffers me acid-base conjugate ratio se buffer pH calculate karne ke liye formula.

references.citation: Nelson D. L. & Cox M. M. Lehninger Principles of Biochemistry. 8th Edition, W. H. Freeman.
Voet D. & Voet J. G. Biochemistry. 5th Edition, John Wiley & Sons.

topics.contentEn: Enzymes accelerate biochemical reactions by stabilizing transition states. Steady-state Michaelis-Menten kinetics mathematically models initial velocity as a function of substrate concentration.
topics.contentHinglish: Enzymes transition state ko stabilize karke activation energy decrease karte hain. Michaelis-Menten equation initial velocity aur substrate concentration ka relation deti hai.
keyPoints: Km represents substrate concentration at half-maximal velocity (Vmax/2) reflecting binding affinity
Competitive inhibition increases apparent Km without changing Vmax; Lineweaver-Burk lines pivot on the 1/v0 y-axis intercept

description.en: Mendelian inheritance, linkage mapping, recombination, chromosome aberrations, gene interactions, and population genetics.
description.hinglish: Mendelian principles, gene mapping, recombination frequency, chromosomal abnormalities, aur population genetics.

overview.en: Genetics governs the transmission and variation of biological traits across generations. It covers classical cross-breeding models, quantitative inheritance, three-point testcross mapping, and Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium.
overview.hinglish: Genetics biological traits ke inheritance aur variation ko samjhati hai. Isme Mendel ke laws, linkage mapping, chromosomal mutations, aur population genetics shamil hain.

en: Calculate recombination frequencies and gene order from three-point testcross data
Solve non-Mendelian epistatic ratio modifications (9:7, 12:3:1, 9:3:4, 15:1)
Compute Hardy-Weinberg allele and genotype frequencies under selection pressure
hinglish: Three-point testcross data se gene order aur map distance (cM) nikalna
Modified epistatic ratios aur gene interaction problems solve karna
Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium equations se allele frequencies calculate karna

description.en: Predicts allele and genotype distribution in an idealized non-evolving population.
description.hinglish: Ideal population me allele aur genotype frequencies predict karne ka fundamental formula.

references.citation: Griffiths A. J. F. et al. Introduction to Genetic Analysis. 12th Edition, W. H. Freeman.
Klug W. S. et al. Concepts of Genetics. 12th Edition, Pearson.

topics.contentEn: Linkage mapping deduces linear chromosomal gene arrangement by quantifying crossing-over frequencies between heterozygous loci and homozygous recessive testers.
topics.contentHinglish: Three-point testcross me recombinant frequencies calculate karke teen genes ka accurate linear order aur inter-genic distances (centimorgans) nikaale jate hain.
keyPoints: Double cross-over (DCO) classes have the lowest numerical frequency; comparing DCO with parental classes identifies the middle gene
Coefficient of Coincidence (C) = Observed DCO / Expected DCO ; Interference (I) = 1 - C

description.en: Central dogma mechanisms: DNA replication fidelity, transcription regulation, RNA processing, translation mechanisms, and operon control.
description.hinglish: DNA replication, transcription, RNA splicing, translation machinery, lac/trp operon regulation, aur molecular repair systems.

overview.en: Molecular Biology elucidates the information flow from nucleotide sequences to functional proteins. It details polymerases, topoisomerases, spliceosomes, ribosomal catalytic peptidyl transferase centers, and epigenetic chromatin dynamics.
overview.hinglish: Molecular Biology biological information ke flow ko explain karti hai. Isme replication fork proteins, RNA polymerase regulation, aur operon switches detail me covered hain.

en: Detail bacterial and eukaryotic replication fork progression and proofreading excision
Analyze promoter architecture, sigma factors, and general transcription factors (TFIID, TFIIH)
Explain mRNA post-transcriptional processing: 5' capping, spliceosomal intron excision, and polyadenylation
Interpret negative and positive gene regulatory circuits in Lac, Trp, and Ara operons
hinglish: Prokaryotic aur eukaryotic replication machinery aur proofreading mechanisms samajhna
RNA polymerase holoenzyme promoters aur transcription factors ko map karna
Pre-mRNA splicing, 5' cap, aur 3' poly-A tail ke biochemical steps ko verify karna
Lac aur Trp operons ke induction, repression, aur attenuation mechanisms ko master karna

references.citation: Watson J. D. et al. Molecular Biology of the Gene. 7th Edition, Pearson.
Krebs J. E. et al. Lewin's GENES XII. Jones & Bartlett Learning.

title.en: DNA Replication in Prokaryotes: Molecular Architecture and Fidelity

topics.contentEn: Replication in E. coli initiates at oriC where DnaA oligomerizes to melt 13-mer AT-rich repeats. DnaB helicase unwinds duplex DNA, stabilized by SSB proteins.
topics.contentHinglish: E. coli me replication oriC par shuru hota hai. DnaB helicase DNA strands ko separate karta hai aur DNA Polymerase III holoenzyme leading aur lagging strands synthesize karta hai.
keyPoints: DNA Polymerase III core contains alpha (polymerase), epsilon (3' to 5' exonuclease proofreader), and theta subunits
Beta clamp confers high processivity (>5000 nucleotides per binding event)
DNA Polymerase I utilizes 5' to 3' exonuclease nick translation to remove RNA primers

description.en: Bacterial morphology, cell wall architecture, culture kinetics, microbial genetics, pathogenic mechanisms, and industrial fermentation strains.
description.hinglish: Bacteria, viruses, fungi ka classification, cell wall structure, microbial growth kinetics, sterilization, aur antibiotic resistance.

overview.en: Microbiology covers microscopic biological entities driving biogeochemical cycles and bioprocess applications. It encompasses peptidoglycan crosslinking, endotoxins, horizontal gene transfer, and sterilization kinetics.
overview.hinglish: Microbiology bacteria, viruses, aur fungi ke biological study ko cover karti hai. Isme Gram staining, bacterial growth curves, aur industrial strain applications detailed hain.

en: Differentiate Gram-positive and Gram-negative peptidoglycan and outer membrane lipopolysaccharide architecture
Calculate specific growth rate, doubling time, and yield coefficients from batch growth kinetics
Compare mechanisms of horizontal gene transfer: Transformation, Transduction, and Conjugation
hinglish: Gram-positive aur Gram-negative cell wall ke molecular differences ko identify karna
Bacterial growth curve se doubling time aur specific growth rate (mu) calculate karna
Transformation, Transduction, aur Conjugation ke mechanisms ko trace karna

references.citation: Madigan M. T. et al. Brock Biology of Microorganisms. 16th Edition, Pearson.
Willey J. M. et al. Prescott's Microbiology. 11th Edition, McGraw-Hill.

description.en: Innate immunity, antigen presentation, antibody classes, V(D)J recombination, MHC restriction, and hypersensitivity reactions.
description.hinglish: Innate aur adaptive immunity, antibody structure, MHC Class I/II pathways, T-cell activation, autoimmunity, aur vaccines.

overview.en: Immunology analyzes host defense systems against biological pathogens. It explores clonal selection, somatic hypermutation, cytokine signaling, monoclonal antibodies, and vaccine design.
overview.hinglish: Immunology immune system ke defense mechanisms ko analyze karti hai. Isme antibodies, MHC proteins, T cell receptors, aur immunological assays shamil hain.

en: Outline immunoglobulin domain structure and compare effector functions of IgG, IgM, IgA, IgE, and IgD
Trace antigen processing and presentation via cytosolic (MHC-I) and endocytic (MHC-II) pathways
Differentiate Coombs & Gell Hypersensitivity mechanisms Types I, II, III, and IV
hinglish: Antibodies ke 5 classes aur unke functions ko accurately compare karna
MHC Class I aur Class II antigen presentation pathways ko step-by-step trace karna
Hypersensitivity reactions ke 4 types ko clinically aur mechanistically differentiate karna

references.citation: Punt J. et al. Kuby Immunology. 8th Edition, W. H. Freeman.
Murphy K. & Weaver C. Janeway's Immunobiology. 9th Edition, Garland Science.

description.en: Restriction endonucleases, cloning vectors, expression systems, CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing, PCR methodologies, and DNA libraries.
description.hinglish: Restriction enzymes, plasmid vectors, gene cloning, blue-white screening, PCR variants, aur CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing.

overview.en: Genetic Engineering represents the toolkit for targeted modification of genetic material. It covers restriction cleavage, ligation, transformation, site-directed mutagenesis, and recombinant therapeutic production.
overview.hinglish: Genetic Engineering recombinant DNA banane aur organisms ke genome ko modify karne ki technology hai. Isme cloning vectors, PCR, aur CRISPR Cas9 shamil hain.

en: Select appropriate restriction endonucleases, ligases, and phosphatases for directional sticky-end cloning
Design CRISPR-Cas9 single guide RNAs (sgRNAs) matching 5'-NGG-3' PAM sites for double-strand cleavage
Compare recombinant protein expression across bacterial, yeast, insect, and mammalian platforms
hinglish: Cloning ke liye sahi restriction enzymes aur vector selection karna
CRISPR-Cas9 sgRNA design aur PAM recognition rules ko master karna
Bacterial vs eukaryotic expression systems ke pros and cons evaluate karna

references.citation: Brown T. A. Gene Cloning and DNA Analysis: An Introduction. 8th Edition, Wiley-Blackwell.
Primrose S. B. & Twyman R. M. Principles of Gene Manipulation and Genomics. 7th Edition, Blackwell.

description.en: Bioreactor design, fluid mechanics, oxygen mass transfer (kLa), sterilization kinetics, upstream fermentation, and downstream processing.
description.hinglish: Bioreactor design, oxygen transfer rate (kLa), media sterilization kinetics, fed-batch fermentation, aur downstream purification.

overview.en: Bioprocess Engineering scales laboratory biological discoveries into industrial-scale production. It explores mass and energy balances, aeration and agitation mechanics, and separation methods.
overview.hinglish: Bioprocess Engineering laboratory research ko commercial production me convert karti hai. Isme stirred tank bioreactors, oxygen transfer kLa, aur chromatography shamil hain.

en: Calculate volumetric mass transfer coefficient (kLa) and oxygen uptake rate in aerobic fermenters
Compute thermal death kinetics (Del factor, D-value, z-value) for media batch and continuous sterilization
Evaluate downstream purification yields across filtration, chromatography, and lyophilization steps
hinglish: Oxygen transfer coefficient (kLa) aur oxygen uptake rate calculate karna
Sterilization Del factor aur thermal inactivation kinetics solve karna
Downstream processing me recovery yield aur product purity determine karna

references.citation: Doran P. M. Bioprocess Engineering Principles. 2nd Edition, Academic Press.
Shuler M. L. et al. Bioprocess Engineering: Basic Concepts. 3rd Edition, Prentice Hall.

description.en: Biological databases, pairwise and multiple sequence alignment (BLAST, Clustal), structural modeling, molecular docking, and phylogenetic trees.
description.hinglish: Biological databases (NCBI, UniProt, PDB), sequence alignment algorithms (BLAST), protein structure modeling, aur phylogenetics.

overview.en: Bioinformatics applies computational and statistical methodologies to biological data. It covers dynamic programming (Smith-Waterman, Needleman-Wunsch), scoring matrices (PAM, BLOSUM), and structural genomics.
overview.hinglish: Bioinformatics biological data ko computational algorithms se analyze karti hai. Isme BLAST algorithms, PAM/BLOSUM scoring matrices, aur 3D protein structure prediction shamil hain.

en: Execute and interpret BLAST searches evaluating E-values, bit scores, and alignment coverage
Differentiate PAM and BLOSUM substitution matrices for evolutionary distance matching
Construct and root phylogenetic trees using Neighbor-Joining, Maximum Parsimony, and Maximum Likelihood
hinglish: BLAST search results me E-value aur bit score ka accurate biological meaning nikalna
PAM aur BLOSUM matrices ke difference aur selection criteria ko samajhna
Phylogenetic trees construct karke evolutionary distances analyze karna

references.citation: Pevsner J. Bioinformatics and Functional Genomics. 3rd Edition, Wiley-Blackwell.
Xiong J. Essential Bioinformatics. Cambridge University Press.

description.en: Plant tissue culture, Agrobacterium tumefaciens Ti plasmid transformation, transgenic crops, mammalian cell culture, monoclonal hybridomas, and stem cell biology.
description.hinglish: Plant tissue culture, Agrobacterium-mediated gene transfer, transgenic crops, animal cell culture, hybridoma technology, aur stem cells.

overview.en: Plant and Animal Biotechnology focuses on cell culture systems and transgenic modifications of multicellular eukaryotes. It covers totipotency, binary vectors, somatic cell nuclear transfer, and regenerative therapies.
overview.hinglish: Ye subject plants aur animals me biotechnology applications ko cover karta hai. Isme tissue culture, transgenic animals, monoclonal antibodies, aur stem cells shamil hain.

en: Formulate plant tissue culture media manipulating auxin-to-cytokinin ratios for organogenesis versus embryogenesis
Trace Agrobacterium Ti plasmid vir gene induction and T-DNA nuclear integration into plant genomes
Detail hybridoma generation using PEG fusion and HAT selective medium for monoclonal antibody synthesis
hinglish: Auxin aur cytokinin ratio se shoot aur root development control karna
Agrobacterium vir gene cascade aur T-DNA transfer mechanism ko explain karna
HAT medium selection mechanism se hybridoma cells isolate karna

references.citation: Slater A. et al. Plant Biotechnology: The Genetic Manipulation of Plants. 2nd Edition, Oxford University Press.
Freshney R. I. Culture of Animal Cells: A Manual of Basic Technique and Specialized Applications. 7th Edition, Wiley.

description.en: Intellectual property rights, patentability criteria, WTO/TRIPS, plant variety protection, biosafety regulatory committees (IBSC, RCGM, GEAC), and bioethics.
description.hinglish: Patents, copyright, trademarks, TRIPS agreement, Indian biosafety guidelines (IBSC, RCGM, GEAC), aur bioethical considerations.

overview.en: IPR, Biosafety, and Bioethics define the legal, ethical, and safety boundaries of biotechnological innovations. It covers patent law criteria, GMO containment levels, and statutory regulatory bodies in India.
overview.hinglish: Ye subject biotechnology ke legal, safety, aur ethical rules ko explain karta hai. Isme patent filing rules, BSL containment levels, aur GEAC/RCGM approval protocols shamil hain.

en: Analyze patentability criteria: Novelty, Non-obviousness/Inventive Step, and Industrial Utility
Differentiate Indian regulatory roles of IBSC, RCGM, and GEAC in GMO development and release
Categorize biological containment standards across Biosafety Levels 1 through 4 (BSL-1 to BSL-4)
hinglish: Patent grant karne ke teen fundamental criteria evaluate karna
IBSC, RCGM, aur GEAC ke legal roles aur clearance hierarchies ko samajhna
BSL-1 se BSL-4 containment requirements aur risk groups ko identify karna

keyFormulas.name: Risk Assessment Factor (Biosafety)
keyFormulas.formula: Risk = Severity of Hazard * Likelihood of Exposure

description.en: Standard qualitative framework used in GMO environmental and laboratory risk assessment.
description.hinglish: Laboratory containment aur GMO field trials me risk index calculate karne ka protocol.

references.citation: Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Government of India. Regulations and Guidelines for Recombinant DNA Research and Biocontainment.
World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO). WIPO Intellectual Property Handbook.

articles.title: CRISPR-Cas9 Molecular Precision: Mechanistic Insight & RNP Delivery
articles.summary: In-depth molecular analysis of Cas9 endonuclease ribonucleoprotein complex, PAM recognition (5'-NGG-3'), and double-strand break repair via NHEJ versus HDR.
articles.content:
Molecular Structure of Cas9 Endonuclease

Streptococcus pyogenes Cas9 (SpCas9) is a multi-domain endonuclease that associates with a chimeric single guide RNA (sgRNA). Cas9 comprises two structural lobes: the Recognition (REC) lobe and the Nuclease (NUC) lobe.

PAM Recognition & Strand Cleavage

Target search involves scanning genomic DNA for the 5'-NGG-3' protospacer adjacent motif (PAM) by the PAM-interacting domain (PID). Strand separation is initiated, followed by RNA-DNA hybridization.
articles.author: BioScience Editorial Board

opportunities.title: Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Structural Biology & Cryo-EM
opportunities.description: DST-SERB sponsored project investigating viral envelope glycoproteins using single-particle cryo-electron microscopy and biochemical reconstitution.
opportunities.eligibility: M.Sc. in Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Life Sciences with CSIR-UGC NET (JRF/LS) or valid GATE score.
opportunities.qualification: Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences with national entrance qualification.

opportunities.title: Science Academies Summer Research Fellowship Programme (SRFP)
opportunities.description: Two-month prestigious summer research fellowship under fellowship guides across national institutions (IISc, TIFR, IITs, CSIR institutes).
opportunities.eligibility: Undergraduate and postgraduate biotechnology and life sciences students with minimum 65% aggregate score.
opportunities.qualification: B.Sc. (2nd/3rd year), M.Sc. (1st year), or B.Tech (3rd year)

opportunities.title: DBT-Junior Research Fellowship (DBT-JRF / BET)

examinations.examPattern: CBT, 180 Minutes, 60 questions divided into Section A (MCQs), Section B (MSQs), Section C (NATs).
examinations.markingScheme: Section A: Negative marking. Section B & C: No negative marking.
examinations.importantDatesText: Annual exam conducted in February across Indian centers.
examinations.statusNote: Admission into M.Sc., Joint M.Sc.-Ph.D. at IITs and Integrated Ph.D. at IISc.

examinations.syllabusSummary: Microbiology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, Genetics, Molecular Biology, Plant Physiology, Animal Physiology, Ecology, Evolution, Techniques in Biology.
examinations.eligibilitySummary: Bachelor degree in Science with biological subjects from a recognized university.
examinations.examPattern: CBT, 105 Minutes, 75 domain-specific questions (General Part A removed from 2024 onwards).
examinations.importantDatesText: Conducted annually in March for central and participating state universities.
examinations.statusNote: Single entrance gateway for JNU, BHU, DU, Hyd University M.Sc. Life Sciences / Biotechnology programs.

examinations.fullName: Joint CSIR-UGC NET for JRF and Lectureship - Life Sciences
examinations.conductingAgency: National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of CSIR
examinations.syllabusSummary: 13 Comprehensive Units: Molecules, Cellular Organization, Fundamental Processes, Cell Communication, Developmental Biology, System Physiology (Plant/Animal), Inheritance Biology, Diversity of Life, Ecological Principles, Evolution, Applied Biology, Methods in Biology.

aiWeeklyDispatches.fullDraftHtml:
BioScience Weekly Dispatch — Issue #45 (2026)

BioScience Hub Official Academic Intelligence & Opportunity Digest

Weekly curated digest of verified biotechnology vacancies, fellowships, summer internships, and national examination schedules.

1. Verified Research & Job Vacancies

  • Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Structural Biology & Cryo-EM — Regional Centre for Biotechnology (RCB), Faridabad (Deadline: 2026-11-25) Official Link

2. Fellowships & Internships

  • Science Academies Summer Research Fellowship Programme (SRFP) — Indian Academy of Sciences, Bengaluru (Deadline: 2026-11-15) Apply
  • DBT-Junior Research Fellowship (DBT-JRF / BET) — Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Govt. of India (Deadline: 2026-03-20) Apply

3. National Competitive Examinations Update

  • GAT-B (Graduate Aptitude Test - Biotechnology): 2026 cycle concluded (Exam held 17 May 2026). Official 2027 session bulletin expected early 2027.
  • DBT-JRF (Biotechnology Eligibility Test (BET) / DBT-JRF): Annual examination cycle. 2027 notification scheduled for announcement by NTA/DBT.
  • GATE-BT (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering - Biotechnology): Annual national examination held in February.
  • IIT-JAM (Joint Admission Test for Masters - Biotechnology (BT)): Annual exam conducted in February across Indian centers.
Grounded strictly in official gazettes and agency bulletins (DBT, DST, CSIR, NTA). Distributed via BioScience Hub.
